verdict.rationale: Claude's stable Data residency docs describe a Workspace geo setting in the Claude Console that controls where data is stored at rest. A separate per-request Inference geo setting controls where model inference runs, with "global" and "us" options. Missing for 10: the regions available for Workspace geo storage are not listed, the only inference region documented is the US, there is no evidence the control applies to the consumer Claude apps beyond Console workspaces, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Data residency controls let you manage where your data is processed and stored.
Workspace geo: Controls where data is stored at rest and where endpoint processing (such as image transcoding and code execution) occurs. Configured at the workspace level in the Claude Console.
